create_token: create a JWT token from a dictionary payload with an optional expiration delta
verify_password: verify a plain password against a bcrypt-hashed password string
create_admin_user: create an admin user with email, password, and optional name for headless deployment
verify_signature: verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature of a string payload using a trusted secret key
get_password_hash: hash a plaintext password using bcrypt with auto-generated salt
